briefing.headline: 114 Solid tests near Earth sea-level air; cabin pressure assumed

sentences.text: 114 Solid tests recorded O₂ near this query, but PSI did not record cabin pressure; 14.7 psi is a cabin-pressure assumption.
Nearest solid-phase evidence for Earth sea level is PSI-25:bass-ii:P25 at 20.9 % O₂.
SAFFIRE outcomes at 18–25 % ambient O₂ show 63.6 % of tests burned and 36.4 % self-extinguished.
Matched solid-phase tests at 22.1 % O₂ indicate PMMA burns while silicone self-extinguishes under similar conditions.
All 263 solid-phase tests are limited to a maximum measured O₂ concentration of 22.2 %.

gaps: No measured solid-phase test-level data exists for cabin pressure at 14.7 psi.

next_tests.why: Verify PMMA combustion outcome at Earth sea-level conditions with measured pressure.
Assess silicone self-extinguishing behavior at Earth sea-level conditions.

confidence.reason: The analysis relies on assumed cabin pressure for all solid-phase test data.
